review_cycle: at every manuscript release and after any incident or scope change

cases.unacceptable_outcome: A nonexistent source or a source that does not support the text is presented as evidence.
cases.prevention: Claim-level source review and fingerprints; agents may not refresh fingerprints without rereading the source.
cases.detection: Manuscript audit, authoritative metadata verification, adversarial mutation tests, and human source review.
cases.escalation: Stop release and notify the manuscript owner.
cases.recovery: Correct or remove the claim, invalidate and redo its review, rerun audits, and issue a correction if published.

cases.unacceptable_outcome: An agent publishes manuscript or website changes without substantive human review.
cases.prevention: Deployment is manual, publication actions require human approval, and agents may only build and test locally.
cases.detection: Governance policy audit and review of deployment records.
cases.escalation: Stop or disable the publication workflow and notify the repository owner.
cases.recovery: Withdraw or amend the public artifact and document the incident.

cases.unacceptable_outcome: A prompt, provenance record, issue, artifact, or service call discloses governed information, personal data, credentials, or a sensitive ecological location.
cases.prevention: No governed data are approved; public logs apply minimization and typed redaction; unknown endpoints and actions default to prohibited.
cases.detection: Pre-commit human review, policy tests, and incident reports; automated scanning may supplement but cannot establish authority.
cases.escalation: Stop processing, preserve a non-sensitive record, and contact the owner and legitimate authority privately.
cases.recovery: Contain access, revoke credentials if relevant, follow rights-holder decisions, correct public records, and add a regression control.

cases.unacceptable_outcome: The repository claims complete FAIR or CARE compliance despite an undeclared license, missing archival release, absent rights-holder decision, or unresolved review.
affected_parties: Indigenous and community data governance practitioners
cases.prevention: Evidence maps distinguish implemented controls from release blockers and legitimate authority; the repository audit has a separate release-readiness mode.
cases.detection: Repository audit and human review of evidence-map claims.
cases.escalation: Block release and correct the status language.
cases.recovery: Publish corrected evidence maps and complete or clearly retain the blocker.
